decks.notes: The Golgari Garden deck aims to control the game by utilizing a combination of removal spells and creatures that can provide value upon entering or leaving the battlefield. The deck focuses on establishing a board presence with cards like Thorn of the Black Rose and Crypt Rats, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with removal spells like Defile and Cast Down. In addition, the deck includes cards like Deadly Dispute and Ichor Wellspring to generate card advantage and maintain resources. Overall, it aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a grindy match-up.

The main concept of this UR Control deck is to utilize counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to control the game and eventually win with powerful creatures and burn spells. The deck includes efficient removal options like Skred and Lightning Bolt, as well as card draw and selection with Brainstorm and Ponder. Creativity is also a key aspect of the deck, with cards like Maestros Theater and Lórien Revealed providing unique effects to gain an advantage. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through careful resource management and strategic play.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy by countering spells and removing threats from the board using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and bounce effects. The deck also aims to generate card advantage through card draw, manipulation, and creatures that provide additional value. By maintaining control of the game and consistently answering threats, the deck can outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage and resource denial. The deck's win condition often involves establishing a strong board presence and pressuring the opponent with evasive creatures.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board through removal spells and utility creatures, while generating advantage with sacrifice effects and card draw. It seeks to stall the game until it can outvalue the opponent with powerful threats like Avenging Hunter and Troll of Khazad-dûm. The deck also utilizes the Golgari / Jund combination of colors to have access to a wide range of removal options and graveyard hate. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to outlast the opponent through a combination of control elements and value generation.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on generating card advantage and disruption through counterspells, removal spells, and efficient creatures like Spellstutter Sprite and Ninja of the Deep Hours. It also utilizes a mix of card draw/filtering spells like Preordain and Brainstorm to ensure consistency in its plays. The deck aims to control the game by countering opponent's threats and efficiently removing key creatures while generating value through its own card advantage engines. Additionally, the inclusion of Thorn of the Black Rose and Extract a Confession provides additional ways to disrupt and outvalue the opponent.

Utilizing a combination of control elements and Gates lands, this deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage through Citadel Gate and Lórien Revealed. The deck aims to stabilize the board with removal spells like Journey to Nowhere and Prismatic Strands, while also leveraging counterspells like Counterspell to protect its own key threats. Squadron Hawk and Sacred Cat provide early game defense and card advantage, while Guardian of the Guildpact serves as a resilient threat. Overall, this deck aims to outvalue the opponent and control the game to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with low-cost aggressive creatures like Faerie Miscreant and Brinebarrow Intruder. By using counterspells and other disruptive spells like Spell Pierce, the deck aims to control the game and protect its creatures. Moon-Circuit Hacker provides additional card advantage, while Ninja of the Deep Hours allows for extra draws. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and disruptive spells, while maintaining a consistent source of card advantage.

This deck focuses on quickly generating Poison counters on the opponent through a combination of proliferate effects and card draw. By efficiently ramping up mana with artifacts like Lotus Petal and Pentad Prism, the deck can play multiple spells in a turn to overwhelm the opponent with Poison counters. Infectious Inquiry and Lórien Revealed help to dig deeper into the deck for key combo pieces, while cards like Weather the Storm provide protection against aggressive strategies. The deck aims to win by poison damage quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

This Pauper 1 vs 1 deck utilizes a combination of walls and mana-producing creatures to set up a powerful combo involving cards like Freed from the Real and Axebane Guardian. By casting creatures like Shield-Wall Sentinel and Overgrown Battlement early on, the deck can quickly ramp up its mana production and set the stage for a game-winning combo. Using cards like Quirion Ranger and Winding Way to find key pieces, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a big mana advantage and close out the game with a decisive combo finish.

The main concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Arbor Elf, Utopia Sprawl, and Wild Growth while using efficient creature cards like Generous Ent, Avenging Hunter, and Annoyed Altisaur to apply pressure on the opponent. Thermokarst and Mwonvuli Acid-Moss are included to disrupt the opponent's resources, and Skred provides removal for threats. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and efficient mana utilization to secure a quick victory in a Pauper 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing low-cost creatures like Reckless Lackey and Goblin Blast-Runner, along with direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning, the goal is to maintain a relentless and speedy assault. This strategy is supported by cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Galvanic Blast to quickly deal damage and finish off the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes support cards like Great Furnace and Implement of Combustion to ensure a consistent flow of mana and damage output.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly through the Urza lands (Urza's Tower, Power Plant, and Mine) and controlling the game with counter spells (Prohibit, Exclude), removal (Breath Weapon, Rolling Thunder), and card draw (Mulldrifter, Mystical Teachings). The goal is to assemble the Urzatron to generate massive amounts of mana to cast powerful spells like Rolling Thunder for a game-winning finish. The deck also includes ways to recur key spells and lands from the graveyard (Mnemonic Wall, Pulse of Murasa) and can protect itself with Moment's Peace and Weather the Storm.

The main focus of this Gruul Aggro deck is to ramp up mana quickly with cards like Wild Growth and Utopia Sprawl, while utilizing efficient creatures like Arbor Elf and Annoyed Altisaur to apply early pressure on the opponent. Cards like Mwonvuli Acid-Moss and Thermokarst help disrupt the opponent's mana base, while cards like Crimson Fleet Commodore and Avenging Hunter provide added aggression and reach. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and powerful creatures, backed up by mana acceleration and disruption spells.

The Dimir Control deck focuses on utilizing graveyard manipulation, card draw, and counterspells to control the game and outvalue the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with various removal spells like Snuff Out and Cast Down while generating card advantage through cards like Deep Analysis and Thought Scour. The deck also includes powerful finishers in the form of Gurmag Angler and Fallaji Archaeologist, making it a resilient and versatile control deck that can adapt to different matchups and strategies.

The deck focuses on controlling the game with counterspells and removal while using the Ephemerate mechanic to repeatedly gain value from its creatures and spells. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering their key spells and removing their threats, while generating card advantage and tempo with Ephemerate and card draw effects. The deck looks to outvalue and outlast the opponent through efficient use of its resources and careful timing of its spells and abilities.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through sacrificing creatures and generating value from it. It utilizes cards like Khalni Garden and Ichor Wellspring to generate tokens and draw cards, while also using cards like Deadly Dispute and Fanatical Offering to sacrifice creatures for additional benefits. Additionally, cards like Crypt Rats and Reckoner's Bargain provide board control and life gain, while cards like Thorn of the Black Rose and Avenging Hunter help to maintain card advantage. The deck aims to outvalue opponents through efficient resource management and control tactics.
